about: Real-boundary suites that need no live audio device (models, committed files and the GPU only), so a backup Mac whose audio is "blackhole" may run them (scripts/lib/mac_hosts.py needs_real_audio). Each suite carries the .audioDeviceFree tag in its own source; TestInventoryFreezeTests fails when this list and the tags differ. Add a suite only after checking that nothing it runs opens a microphone, speaker or other audio device.
